newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu ends flat vs dlr in dormant market.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu ends flat vs dlr in dormant market.

text.p: 1435 GMT - Romania's leu currency closed Monday static at 3,255/65 to the dollar in dull interbank trading.
* Traders said intrabank market focus remained on other currencies, which at cross yield rates closer to leu-dollar retail prices of some 3,550.
* Latest central bank data showed a $689,700 interbank volume last Friday, when overall trading was $16.5 million.
* Short-term leu rates idled at some 46 percent in a balanced money market. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
